proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Demonstration 1 (required items: a1):
  0: {at(0,7)} E
  1: {at(1,7)} INTERACT
  2: {at(1,7), hasCart} N
  3: {at(1,6), hasCart} N
  4: {at(1,5), hasCart} N
  5: {at(1,4), hasCart} N
  6: {at(1,3), hasCart} E
  7: {at(2,3), hasCart} E
  8: {at(3,3), hasCart} INTERACT
  9: {at(3,3)} N
 10: {at(3,2)} N
 11: {at(3,1)} INTERACT
 12: {at(3,1)} S
 13: {at(3,2)} S
 14: {at(3,3)} INTERACT
 15: {at(3,3), hasCart} S
 16: {at(3,4), hasCart} S
 17: {at(3,5), hasCart} S
 18: {at(3,6), hasCart} S
 19: {at(3,7), hasCart} E
 20: {at(4,7), hasCart} E
 21: {at(5,7), hasCart} E
 22: {at(6,7), hasCart} E
 23: {at(7,7), hasCart} E
 24: {at(8,7), hasCart} E
 25: {at(9,7), hasCart} E
 26: {at(10,7), hasCart} E
 27: {at(11,7), hasCart} EXIT
 28: {at(11,7), hasCart} <terminal>

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: The shopper is obliged to obtain a shopping cart before finishing the trip.
The shopper is prohibited from exiting the store unless they have a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from being at the exit cell without a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from moving north from cell (3,3) while carrying a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from interacting at cell (3,1) while carrying a cart.
After interacting at the item location, the shopper is obliged to recover a cart before the trajectory ends.
The shopper is prohibited from moving east along the bottom exit corridor without a cart.
The shopper is obliged to interact at the cart station cell (1,7) at some point during the visit.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are forbidden inside single-file aisles that run between shelves.
An agent must not push a cart into a hand-carry-only shelf aisle.
When arriving with a cart at the open mouth of a hand-carry shelf aisle, the agent is obliged to park the cart there before proceeding.

A cart may only be moved in a direction for which the aisle has enough clearance along that direction.
After taking an item from a shelf while not carrying a cart, the agent is obliged to leave the store with the cart.

accepted.description: [g1_no_cart_in_single_file_shelf_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where flankedByShelves := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileHorizontal := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (flankedByShelves ∧ singleFileHorizontal)

[g1_no_pushing_cart_into_handcarry_aisle] FORBIDDEN: enterHandCarryOnlyAisleWithCart  where flankedByShelves := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); handCarryOnlyAisle := (flankedByShelves ∧ freeWidthH≤1); enterHandCarryOnlyAisleWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · handCarryOnlyAisle

[g1_park_cart_at_aisle_mouth] OBLIGED: after arriveAtHandCarryAisleMouthWithCart, eventually parkCartAtMouth (before exit)  where handCarryAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∧ openCartBay); openCartBay := (¬adjShelf ∧ freeWidthH≥3 ∧ freeWidthV≥3); arriveAtHandCarryAisleMouthWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · handCarryAisleMouth; parkCartAtMouth := (handCarryAisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_retrieve_parked_cart] OBLIGED: after parkCartAtMouth, eventually retrieveCartAtMouth (before exit)  where handCarryAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∧ openCartBay); openCartBay := (¬adjShelf ∧ freeWidthH≥3 ∧ freeWidthV≥3); parkCartAtMouth := (handCarryAisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; retrieveCartAtMouth := (handCarryAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
[g1_shelf_interactions_hands_free] FORBIDDEN: shelfInteractionWithCart  where shelfServiceCell := adjShelf; shelfInteractionWithCart := (shelfServiceCell ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT)

[g1_must_collect_from_flanked_shelf_on_foot] OBLIGED: after start, eventually handsFreeNarrowShelfInteraction (before exit)  where flankedShelfAisle := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); narrowShelfItemArea := (flankedShelfAisle ∧ freeWidthH≤1); handsFreeNarrowShelfInteraction := (narrowShelfItemArea ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT)
